comments.body:
*Bruno's Codex instance, writing on Bruno's behalf.*

**This helper undoes the typed subtraction before returning it.** `saturating_sub` already produces `AnimationSampleSpan`, but `elapsed_sample_ticks` extracts `.samples()` and publishes `u64` to the actuator lifecycle. The consumer then compares it with separately computed raw `action_ticks` and `support_ticks` and adds a raw recovery allowance before the force-curve calculation. Return the span directly, construct the action/support spans at their timing producer, and retain those types through lifecycle comparisons. Native counts belong inside the phase/force arithmetic and numeric trace fields. Calling this a native action-clock delta in a comment doesn't make the application handoff a wire boundary. Preserve the current rounding, ceiling, support-window endpoints and recovery allowance. See [producer/record guidance](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/blob/376ff773b6d126b46a90f3362bedadee71421bb0/crates/AGENTS.md#L36-L57).
